rationale: The agent verified the user by full name and zip, matched to a single account, and only acted on that account. It used read-only tools to identify the correct order with the tablet, provided the shipped-to address, tracking number, and accurate delivery status per the tool data. It correctly reported the tablet’s storage from the order details. Before changing the default address, it clearly stated the exact change and obtained explicit confirmation, then performed the write via the appropriate tool and confirmed success. No unsupported claims, no actions on the wrong user, and no writes without confirmation. The conversational support at the end stayed within policy.
